title: 航空燃油系統安全概念
summary: 以「用質量、通氣、相容性及隔離證據理解燃油安全架構」為主線，在燃油管路方塊圖與非接觸資料台中依序完成體積密度與能量基準、通氣阻塞的壓差概念、電位差與搭接檢查概念、供油與量測的共因界面、燃料批次與零件版本及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Understand fuel safety through inventory, venting, compatibility and isolation evidence in a Fuel-system block diagrams and non-contact data bench, progressing through Volume, density and energy basis, Differential pressure under vent restriction, Potential difference and bonding evidence, Common-cause fuel-supply and sensing interfaces, Fuel batches and part revisions, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 體積密度與能量基準：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Volume, density and energy basis: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 體積密度與能量基準 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Volume, density and energy basis and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「航空燃油系統安全概念」中，本單元處理「體積密度與能量基準」。燃料能量取決於質量與低位熱值；等體積替換不保證等質量或等能量。
steps.instructionEn: Within Aircraft fuel-system safety concepts, this unit examines Volume, density and energy basis. Fuel energy depends on mass and lower heating value; equal volume does not ensure equal mass or energy.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：體積 V=20 L、密度ρ=0.8 kg/L、低位熱值H=43 MJ/kg。關係式 E=VρH；含輸出單位換算的算式 20*0.8*43，結果 688 MJ。適用範圍：假想燃料性質；未證明燃料合格、引擎相容或排放等效。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Volume V=20 L, density rho=0.8 kg/L and LHV H=43 MJ/kg. Relation E=VρH; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 20*0.8*43 gives 688 MJ. Applicability: Hypothetical fuel properties; not proof of qualification, engine compatibility or emissions equivalence.
steps.failure: 在「體積密度與能量基準」的情境中，按體積採購卻按質量比較效率時，密度基準不一致會誤導。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Volume, density and energy basis, Purchasing by volume while comparing mass efficiency can conceal inconsistent density bases.
steps.check: 針對「體積密度與能量基準」，分開列密度、熱值、黏度與材料浸泡試驗，避免以能量一項代替相容性。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Volume, density and energy basis, Track density, heating value, viscosity and material-soak evidence separately. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只把 ρ 改為0.76 kg/L，其餘條件固定。用 20*0.76*43 重算，結果從 688 變成 653.6 MJ。先預測方向，再記下對「體積密度與能量基準」的意義與一項不能外推的結論。只在離線模型或紙上完成。
knowledge.textEn: Change only rho to 0.76 kg/L, holding all other conditions fixed. Recalculate 20*0.76*43: 688 becomes 653.6 MJ. Predict the direction, explain its meaning for Volume, density and energy basis, and state one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated. Work only in offline models or on paper.
